vo.text: Want to finally learn coding or AI... and actually finish this time?
A few minutes a day. And you're not just watching... you're building skills you can use right away.
Write your first line of code... then your first real app.
Put AI to work. Build your own agents, and automate the boring parts of your job.
And because it feels like a game, you'll keep coming back. Day after day, until you finish.
With friends cheering you on, you're never learning alone.
Work is changing fast. Now, you get to stay ahead of it.
And it launches this November! Free to start, on iPhone, Android and web.
Get notified at teyro dot app, and be first in!
